name: Ackee
tagline: Self-hosted, cookieless analytics. GraphQL API, modern UI.
shortDescription: Lightweight, self-hosted, cookieless analytics for techies. GraphQL API, modern UI, no JavaScript required for visitors. The minimal analytics tool.
longDescription:
## What it is

Ackee is a self-hosted analytics platform focused on simplicity. Cookieless, no personal data, no fingerprints, GraphQL API, real-time dashboard, dark mode, and tiny (~2KB tracking script).

## Why we recommend it

If Plausible and Umami feel heavy, Ackee is the minimalist choice. It does the basics — pageviews, referrers, devices, countries — without any of the extras. The tracking script is 2KB.

## When to use it

- Minimal analytics for a static site
- Techies who want a GraphQL API to query
- When you want cookieless + lightweight + self-hosted, nothing else
- A side project that needs analytics without the bloat
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name ackee -p 3000:3000 -v ackee_data:/data electerious/ackee
```

**Heroku / Netlify / Vercel:** One-click deploys supported.
pricingDetails: Free. MIT licensed. Self-host on $5 VPS.
